scripts.dev: npm run build:networking && concurrently -k "npm --workspace apps/networking run build -- -w" "npm --workspace apps/api run dev" "npm --workspace apps/desktop run dev"
scripts.desktop:electron: npm run build:engine && npm --workspace apps/desktop run build && npm --workspace apps/desktop run electron
scripts.check: npm run build:engine && npm --workspace apps/desktop run check && npm --workspace protocol run check
scripts.build:engine: npm --workspace apps/networking run build && npm --workspace apps/api run build
scripts.package: npm run build:engine && npm --workspace apps/desktop run package
scripts.package:dir: npm run build:engine && npm --workspace apps/desktop run package:dir
